description: Updates an attachment's malware access override setting. Use when you need to enable or restrict agent access to attachments that have been flagged for malware.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for the Update Attachment action.

attachment_id.description: The unique ID of the attachment to update
attachment_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the attachment you want to update. Find this from the ticket or attachment listing.
attachment_id.title: Attachment Id

malware_access_override.description: If true, allows agents to access attachments with detected malware. If false, restricts access to malware-detected attachments.
malware_access_override.human_parameter_description: Set to true to enable agent access to attachments flagged as malware. Set to false to restrict access.
malware_access_override.title: Malware Access Override

inputSchema.title: UpdateZendeskAttachmentRequest

content_url.title: Content Url

size.title: Size
